a.lede: Some of the most impressive tech that Adobe showcases at its annual Max conference each year is the experimental features it's developing, and the latest of those tools are being announced today: they can transform images into explorable 3D scenes, design AI characters by talking to them, and turn photo editing into a copy/paste process. […]
a.title: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters

b.lede: Rather than giving consumers yet another photo-editing tool, Phota Labs aims to use advances in AI to automate the editing process so it’s easier for anyone to turn everyday moments into better photos.
b.title: Phota Labs uses AI to turn everyday photos into professional-looking shots
